liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): The emotional peak for this listener was the 'one more day' line, sung with great feeling; Black Peter finally returned about five months after the July show, which the reviewer treats as a comeback marker [26][31]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Jerry is described as fantastic on Tennessee Jed [32]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Bobby is praised for his Desolation Row [35]
- **Samson and Delilah** (1 review): Reviewer thinks this may be the best Samson and Delilah they've heard [32]
- **Ship of Fools** (1 review): Jerry plays every note with perfect bends in Ship of Fools, likened to a captain steering the crowd [34]
- **Drums** (1 other source): A jam with the whole ensemble grows out of Drums before Space [7]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 other source): Brokedown Palace was the encore [1]

## The recordings

- **gd86-12-17.aud.eD.14452.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 174 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it a typical audience recording, worth keeping [26]
- **gd1986-12-17.148871.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 25 songs; 174 min [4]
- **gd1986-12-17.141036.Senn.Hessberg.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: source not stated; 24 songs; 174 min [7]
- **gd1986-12-17.139364.Senn.Hessberg.Miller.Noel.t-flac24**: source not stated; 24 songs; 174 min [8]
- **gd1986-12-17.sbd.miller.77410.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 178 min; rated 3.57/5 by 14 [14]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds great throughout; reviewer wanted a bit more of Brent's keyboard in the mix [32]
- **gd1986-12-17.nakcm304.beckham.suraci.sbeok.80996.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 160 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [25]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was overjoyed to see Jerry upright and singing strongly a few months after his coma [35]
- The crowd is very loud before the show starts, excited to have Jerry back after his health scare [36]
- Reviewer arrived around The Other One, with tickets bought for ten dollars each outside [37]
- Coming from metal shows, reviewer was struck by the large, peaceful crowd that wasn't fighting toward the stage [37]
- Sikiru Adepoju on talking drum and Jose Lorenzo on berimbau and hand percussion are credited as guests [4]
- Reviewer's first show was the Greek in June; says this one felt very different [26]
- Second set runs about as long as the whole July 7, 1986 show, the last before Jerry's coma [31]
- Night three of three after Jerry's illness; rumor said night one had tears and forgotten words, night three had none [34]
- Judged the best of the three welcome-back shows, with very high energy; reviewer also points to 12-27-86 and 12-30-86 [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd86-12-17.aud.eD.14452.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>DAT>CDR [1]. Also: Audience recording on Nak 300 microphones, to DAT then CDR, via Melinda [1]
- **gd1986-12-17.148871.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [4]
- **gd1986-12-17.141036.Senn.Hessberg.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Michael Hessberg Recording: Sennheiser ME80 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M); Charlie Miller DSD [7]. Also: Source 80996, by T. Suraci and D. Beckham, supplies the start and end of one first-set track [7]
- **gd1986-12-17.139364.Senn.Hessberg.Miller.Noel.t-flac24**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Sennheiser ME80 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) [8]. Also: Cross fades were applied where the tape paused [8]
- **gd1986-12-17.sbd.miller.77410.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MX-XG90) D [14]
- **gd1986-12-17.nakcm304.beckham.suraci.sbeok.80996.flac16**: taped by Don Beckham and Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Nak CM304>Sony D5 [25]. Also: Tony taped this show, as part of a run of shows [30]

claims.text: The emotional peak for this listener was the 'one more day' line, sung with great feeling
Reviewer calls it a typical audience recording, worth keeping
Reviewer's first show was the Greek in June; says this one felt very different
Tony taped this show, as part of a run of shows
Second set runs about as long as the whole July 7, 1986 show, the last before Jerry's coma
Black Peter finally returned about five months after the July show, which the reviewer treats as a comeback marker
Soundboard sounds great throughout; reviewer wanted a bit more of Brent's keyboard in the mix
Jerry is described as fantastic on Tennessee Jed
Reviewer thinks this may be the best Samson and Delilah they've heard
Night three of three after Jerry's illness; rumor said night one had tears and forgotten words, night three had none
Jerry plays every note with perfect bends in Ship of Fools, likened to a captain steering the crowd
Bobby is praised for his Desolation Row
Reviewer was overjoyed to see Jerry upright and singing strongly a few months after his coma
Judged the best of the three welcome-back shows, with very high energy; reviewer also points to 12-27-86 and 12-30-86
The crowd is very loud before the show starts, excited to have Jerry back after his health scare
Reviewer arrived around The Other One, with tickets bought for ten dollars each outside
Coming from metal shows, reviewer was struck by the large, peaceful crowd that wasn't fighting toward the stage
Audience recording on Nak 300 microphones, to DAT then CDR, via Melinda
Brokedown Palace was the encore
Chris Hecht made the master cassette; Charlie Miller transferred it and coordinated the release
Sikiru Adepoju on talking drum and Jose Lorenzo on berimbau and hand percussion are credited as guests
A jam with the whole ensemble grows out of Drums before Space
Source 80996, by T. Suraci and D. Beckham, supplies the start and end of one first-set track
Cross fades were applied where the tape paused
